decisions.text: Hit-and-run flagged. Reading plate at the scene, tracking on every camera.
Steer him to Old Bombay Road: only 2 ways out, police can be there 162 s before him. Using 5 signals; 5 uncontrolled turns on the way. Model says 100% he goes that way.
P2 Gachibowli traffic police station: sent to block the spot, in place by T+50 s.
P5 Patrol 5: sent to back-up at the spot, in place by T+93 s.
P4 Patrol 4: sent to cover a side road, in place by T+144 s.
P1 Women police station: sent to cover a side road, in place by T+94 s.
dlf gachibowli: green only towards dlf gachibowli, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
He jumped the red and turned left onto the tertiary road, dodging the traffic held on the right. Off the plan.
New spot on the residential road, 820 m from the old one: 3 ways out, 1 signals re-timed to bring him back, model says 12%.
P4 Patrol 4: re-routed to block the spot, in place by T+130 s.
P1 Women police station: re-routed to back-up at the spot, in place by T+148 s.
P2 Gachibowli traffic police station: re-routed to cover a side road, in place by T+173 s.
P6 Patrol 6: sent to cover a side road, in place by T+203 s.
He turned onto DLF road: an uncontrolled turn, off the plan. Re-planning.
New spot on Old Bombay Road, 820 m from the old one: 2 ways out, 5 signals re-timed to bring him back, model says 62%.
P5 Patrol 5: now block the spot, in place by T+123 s.
P2 Gachibowli traffic police station: re-routed to back-up at the spot, in place by T+124 s.
P1 Women police station: re-routed to cover a side road, in place by T+132 s.
P4 Patrol 4: re-routed to cover a side road, in place by T+131 s.
dlf gachibowli: green only towards dlf gachibowli, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
Old Bombay Road: green only towards Old Bombay Road, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
Old Bombay Road - Gachibowli Main Road: green only towards the secondary road, red on the other 1 exit. He doesn't wait, so he takes it.
Stopped at the planned spot by Gachibowli traffic police station, which was in place 173 s before he arrived.

assumptions: The driver doesn't wait at a red and takes an open exit, leaning to his heading and the bigger road.
Every major junction is treated as having a controllable signal, though the map only records 17 real ones here.
Cameras sit at those junctions and always see him.
Traffic speeds and patrol positions are invented.
